We need to determine the appropriate charge(s) based on the facts.

Facts: In November 2014, defendant Liu purchased a fake seal of \"Lianyungang City Ganyu District Education Bureau\" for 50 RMB. He bought a fake official seal. The prosecution charges him with buying and selling state organ seals (买卖国家机关印章). The list includes a label: \"伪造、变造、买卖国家机关公文、证件、印章\". That matches. So the charge is that.

Thus answer: [罪名]伪造、变造、买卖国家机关公文、证件、印章<eoa>
